name: Assign color codes to celestial bodies and concepts
description: Users requested specific hex or RGB color codes for various subjects, predominantly fictional gas giants, celestial bodies, and alien vegetation defined by atmospheric or chemical compositions. Other requests involved converting color formats, assigning codes to skin tones or game territories, and identifying colors based on visual descriptions or personality traits.
